basic_info.description: Discover refined urban living in this stunning two-level townhouse-style condominium, perfectly positioned on the top floor of a boutique building in San Francisco's vibrant Dogpatch neighborhood. This meticulously renovated home combines the privacy and flow of a single-family residence with condominium convenience.  The gourmet kitchen features custom cabinetry, high-end appliances, and elegant marble countertops with dramatic waterfall edge, plus built-in wine refrigerator. All bathrooms have been completely reimagined with custom vanities and designer tile work, while rich hardwood flooring flows seamlessly across both levels.  This top-floor location offers windows on two sides plus skylights, flooding the space with natural light, while a coveted sliver water view adds serenity. The two-level layout maximizes space and privacy, feeling more like a house than typical condo. Generous storage, in-unit laundry, and one car parking ensure comfort.  Located in one of San Francisco's most dynamic neighborhoods, enjoy easy access to Crane Cove Park's waterfront trails, Chase Center entertainment, renowned restaurants, and vibrant cultural scene, with convenient access to downtown and Silicon Valley. This is more than a condominium - it's a lifestyle.
